name: Yuuki Nene
source: [url=/c1531]Yuuma's[/url] homeroom teacher who teaches modern languages and is also the dorm manager. Nene hates being treated like a kid, but acts and looks like one. Her favorite food is hamburger steak, and she dislikes both carrots and bell peppers. Also owns a cat despite having a cat allergy.
